c.instanceid=i.instanceid where c.JOB_ID=#{jobid} union select '6' flowtype, '【'||c.USER_NAME||' '||substr(flowtitle,-15,8) || '】人员属性变更' AS flowtitle ,i.instanceid,i.flowid,i.flowurl,i.createtime, SELECT E.JOB_ID ,E.USER_NAME ,E.MOBILE,WB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME,E.CERTIFICATE_TYPE,E.CERTIFICATE_NUMBER, E.GRADE,E.PRICE,D.LOCATION ,Y.DICTNAME ,G.GROUPNAME , M.EMPNAME,E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE,D.DEPID,G.ID, E.STATE, E.PRESENCE_STATE,U.OUTSOURCNAME, E.ENTRY_TIME,E.LEAVING_TIME,E.EVALUATION_LEVEL FROM PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC E LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT D ON(E.Dept_Id=to_char(D.DEPID)) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT S.DICTNAME OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME ,S.DICTID OUTSOURCE_TYPE FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY S WHERE S.DICTTYPEID='BUSI_OUTSOURCE_OUTSOURCETYPE' )WB ON(E.OUTSOURCE_TYPE=WB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE) LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE M ON (E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE=M.BADGE) LEFT JOIN COMM_ORGANIZATION O ON(D.COMPID=O.COMPID) LEFT JOIN PPM_DA_TEAM_USER T ON(E.JOB_ID=T.USERID) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT S.DICTNAME,S.DICTID FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY S WHERE S.DICTTYPEID='BUSI_OUTSOURCE_POSITION' )Y ON(Y.DICTID = T.GW) LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO U ON(U.ORGCODE=E.OUTSOURCE_NO) LEFT JOIN PPM_DA_TEAM_GROUP G ON(E.GROUP_ID=G.ID)
INSTR(E.JOB_ID,#{badge} ) > 0 AND
(INSTR(M.EMPNAME, #{empname}) > 0 OR INSTR(E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE, #{empname}) > 0 ) AND
E.entry_time between #{entryStartDate} and #{entryEndDate} AND E.leaving_time between #{leaveStartDate} and #{leaveEndDate} AND INSTR(E.USER_NAME,#{username} ) > 0 AND D.DEPID = #{depid} AND G.ID = #{gro} AND E.STATE = #{state} AND D.DEPID in (${deps}) AND E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE =#{personInCharge} AND E.GROUP_ID in (${groups}) AND E.OUTSOURCE_NO =#{orgcode} AND E.PRESENCE_STATE = (#{presenceState}) AND D.LOCATION is not null AND
ORDER BY E.ENTRY_TIME DESC,e.job_id,e.user_name

GROUP BY person_in_charge ) T

SELECT E.JOB_ID ,E.USER_NAME ,E.MOBILE,WB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME,E.CERTIFICATE_TYPE,E.CERTIFICATE_NUMBER, E.GRADE,E.PRICE,D.LOCATION ,Y.DICTNAME ,G.GROUPNAME , M.EMPNAME,E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE,D.DEPID,G.ID, E.STATE, E.PRESENCE_STATE,U.OUTSOURCNAME, U.ORGCODE, E.ENTRY_TIME,E.LEAVING_TIME FROM PPM_OUTSOURCING_BASIC E LEFT JOIN COMM_DEPARTMENT D ON(E.Dept_Id=to_char(D.DEPID)) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT S.DICTNAME OUTSOURCE_TYPE_NAME ,S.DICTID OUTSOURCE_TYPE FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY S WHERE S.DICTTYPEID='BUSI_OUTSOURCE_OUTSOURCETYPE' )WB ON(E.OUTSOURCE_TYPE=WB.OUTSOURCE_TYPE) LEFT JOIN COMM_EMPLOYEE M ON (E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE=M.BADGE) LEFT JOIN COMM_ORGANIZATION O ON(D.COMPID=O.COMPID) LEFT JOIN PPM_DA_TEAM_USER T ON(E.JOB_ID=T.USERID) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT S.DICTNAME,S.DICTID FROM EOS_DICT_ENTRY S WHERE S.DICTTYPEID='BUSI_OUTSOURCE_POSITION' )Y ON(Y.DICTID = T.GW) LEFT JOIN PPM_OUTSOURCING_INFO U ON(U.ORGCODE=E.OUTSOURCE_NO) LEFT JOIN PPM_DA_TEAM_GROUP G ON(E.GROUP_ID=G.ID)
INSTR(E.JOB_ID,#{badge} ) > 0 AND
(INSTR(M.EMPNAME, #{empname}) > 0 OR INSTR(E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE, #{empname}) > 0 ) AND
E.entry_time between #{entryStartDate} and #{entryEndDate} AND E.leaving_time between #{leaveStartDate} and #{leaveEndDate} AND INSTR(E.USER_NAME,#{username} ) > 0 AND D.DEPID = #{depid} AND G.ID = #{gro} AND E.STATE = #{state} AND D.DEPID in (${deps}) AND E.PERSON_IN_CHARGE =#{personInCharge} AND E.GROUP_ID in (${groups}) AND E.PRESENCE_STATE = (#{presenceState}) AND
ORDER BY E.ENTRY_TIME DESC,e.job_id,e.user_name
